# computesphere_deployment (Resource)

Deprecated: use the resource for the service's type (`computesphere_web_service`, `computesphere_private_service`, `computesphere_worker`, `computesphere_cron_job` or `computesphere_static_site`); a `moved` block carries an existing deployment over without redeploying it. Manages a deployment: a running copy of a service in an environment. Creating this resource creates the deployment, applies any env/secret vars, triggers a deploy, and (by default) waits for it to become ready.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source  = "computesphere/computesphere"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

variable "registry_password" {
  description = "Private registry password / access token"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

# computesphere_deployment is deprecated. Use the resource for the service's
# type instead: computesphere_web_service, computesphere_private_service,
# computesphere_worker, computesphere_cron_job or computesphere_static_site.
# To carry an existing deployment over without redeploying it, replace its
# block with the new resource and add a moved block, e.g.:
#
#   moved {
#     from = computesphere_deployment.example
#     to   = computesphere_web_service.example
#   }

# Public image, optionally with public docker build args.
resource "computesphere_deployment" "example" {
  service_id     = "s1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
  environment_id = "e1f2a3b4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
  project_id     = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890ab"
  type           = "web-service"

  image        = "nginx:latest"
  port         = 80
  sphere_count = 2

  # PUBLIC docker build args — baked into image layers, so never secrets.
  build_args = {
    NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL = "https://api.example.com"
  }

  env_vars = {
    LOG_LEVEL = "info"
  }

  secret_vars = {
    API_KEY = "example-secret-value"
  }
}

# Private image pulled from an authenticated registry.
resource "computesphere_deployment" "private" {
  service_id     = "s2b3c4d5-6789-01bc-def0-234567890abc"
  environment_id = "e1f2a3b4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
  project_id     = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890ab"
  type           = "web-service"

  image          = "myregistry.azurecr.io/app:1.2.3"
  image_type     = "private"
  image_provider = "azure"
  image_url      = "myregistry.azurecr.io"
  image_username = "service-principal-id"
  image_password = var.registry_password
  port           = 8080
}

output "deployment_id" {
  value = computesphere_deployment.example.id
}

output "deployment_status" {
  value = computesphere_deployment.example.status
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Target environment.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project.
- `service_id` (String) Service this deployment runs.
- `type` (String) Resource type (must match the service type, e.g. web-service).

### Optional

- `build_args` (Map of String) PUBLIC docker build args passed to the build. Values are baked into image layers, so they must never carry secrets (use secret_vars for those). Merged over any auto-derived args; an explicit key wins on collision.
- `env_vars` (Map of String) Plain environment variables.
- `image` (String) Container image reference (e.g. nginx:latest) for image-based deployments.
- `image_password` (String, Sensitive) Registry password or access token for a private image. Never logged.
- `image_provider` (String) Registry provider for a private image (e.g. azure, docker, other, custom). Determines how credentials are applied.
- `image_type` (String) Image visibility: "public" (default) or "private". Set to "private" to pull from an authenticated registry using image_provider/image_username/image_password/image_url.
- `image_url` (String) Registry endpoint for a private image. Required for providers that authenticate with username + password (azure, docker, other, custom).
- `image_username` (String) Registry username for a private image.
- `plan_id` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated: the plan comes from the service, and the API refuses a deployment plan that differs from it.
- `port` (Number) Container port.
- `secret_vars` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret environment variables.
- `sphere_count` (Number) Number of spherelets (replicas) to run.
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait for the deployment to reach a ready state after deploying.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Deployment id.
- `name` (String) Deployment name (inherited from the service).
- `status` (String) Current deployment status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = computesphere_deployment.example
  id = "d1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
}
```
